suites.name: MLPerf Inference
suites.comparability: Official submissions; compare only same suite version, scenario, division and accuracy target.

suites.name: InferenceX E2E / AgentX
suites.comparability: Pin recipe commit, model, framework, precision, parallelism, sequence lengths, concurrency and hardware; keep AgentX separate.

suites.name: KernelBench
suites.comparability: Pin task set, evaluator, timeout, compilation policy, hardware and correctness tolerances.

suites.name: KernelBench-Verified
suites.comparability: Do not merge with original KernelBench scores without an explicit task and evaluator mapping.

suites.name: TritonBench
suites.comparability: Pin submodules, PyTorch, Triton, compiler, backend, operation shapes and hardware.

suites.name: GenAI-Perf / Perf Analyzer
suites.comparability: Record request distribution, load model, concurrency, endpoint, client version and server configuration.

principles: A suite definition is not a benchmark result.
Do not compare different suite versions, scenarios, model revisions or measurement boundaries without explicit normalization.
Vendor reports, upstream CI runs and independent reproductions are separate evidence classes.
Every result links to its exact run, recipe or raw artifact.
